posts.title: I fell victim to AI slop
posts.description: How I got scammed into buying AI slop A few months ago, my best friend recommended me a new artist he had stumbled upon. We both love metal music and he knows exactly what excites me, progressive, djenty technical riffs well executed with great sound design. This new band hit all the right boxes. I instantly was drawn to most of their songs from their recent album. This does not happen often.

posts.title: Qiskit Global Summer School 2026
posts.description: This credential earner has learned how to explore quantum computing using Qiskit during the Qiskit Global Summer School 2026. By completing hands-on labs, they have built a solid understanding of quantum computing basics and how to use tools from physics, chemistry, math, and Python to start working with quantum circuits.
